text:
Ryan (Sales): Quick sync — ACME deal asked for a 3-week trial with a live eval. Need to confirm acceptance criteria, security checklist status, and pricing carve-outs. Who can own the eval harness?
Priya (AE): I can run the customer-facing kickoff and collect their top 6 intents/use cases. We need golden examples from their SME.
Maya (Eng): I can build the harness but need the prompt templates and expected outputs. ETA ~5 business days to wire our infra if we have the seed set.
Jordan (TS): For scoring, recommend 3 metrics: precision@top1 (categorical exact), semantic-similarity >= 0.85 (use our embedding model), and a human-rated 1-5 relevance average. Regression gate = no more than 5% drop in human-rated score vs baseline.
Evan (Security): ACME also sent their vendor questionnaire (SaaS+VPC options). I started populating answers — they flagged data residency and KMS. I'll need an engineering signoff for Private deployment notes.
Samira (SRE): On Dedicated vs Hosted: Dedicated committed capacity gives predictable p50 latency. For the trial we can spin up a small dedicated pool, but it impacts pricing. Ops-bot: deploy request queued (REQ-4521).
Priya (AE): Pricing ask: they want a trial discount and a cap on overage. Sales — can we offer 50% off first month + fixed overage cap?
Ryan (Sales): I'll propose 40% off + guaranteed p95 SLA credits. Need finance thumb.
Maya (Eng): Back to harness — here's an example prompt set I want from ACME (please paste into the doc):
```
# Intent A: Invoice parsing
Prompt: "Extract due_date, total_amount, vendor_name from the invoice text. Return JSON"
Golden: {"due_date":"2026-04-30","total_amount":"$12,430.00","vendor_name":"Acme Supplies"}
# Intent B: Customer support triage
Prompt: "Classify urgency and recommended routing (billing/tech/sales). Return code and reason"
Golden: {"urgency":"high","route":"billing","reason":"payment failed on renewal"}
```
Jordan (TS): Scoring snippet — simple rubric: exact match fields = 1 pt each, fuzzy match (Levenshtein / embedding) = 0.5, human review override if score between 0.5-0.8. Pass threshold = 0.8 aggregate.
Evan (Security): On the questionnaire: two blockers — KMS integration timeline (need 2 weeks), and SOC2 attestation copy (we can provide). I flagged them in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ads/acme-security (internal).
Samira (SRE): For regression detection: we should capture token-level latency histograms + token error spikes. If median latency increases >20% vs baseline, fail the gate.
Priya (AE): Action items: 1) ACME to provide 60 golden examples across top intents (owner: ACME SME) 2) Redwood to deliver harness + scoring (owner: Maya) 3) Security questionnaire reply + KMS plan (owner: Evan) 4) Pricing proposal (owner: Ryan)
Ryan (Sales): I'll schedule the kickoff tomorrow 10am PT and add ACME SME. Priya — can you drop the golden example template in the shared drive?
Priya (AE): Done — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ACME-golden-templates. Also added a CSV schema for the harness.
Maya (Eng): I'll stand up the harness on a dev cluster and post a ZIP with the scaffolding and a sample scoring script. Expect a link by EOD Friday.
Evan (Security): I'll upload the completed questionnaire draft and the KMS proposal. Note: Private deployment adds 2-3 weeks to timeline.
Samira (SRE): If customer agrees to hosted with strict contract terms we can shorten to 2 weeks. Otherwise plan for 4-5 weeks for private/Dedicated prep.
Ryan (Sales): Great. For next steps: Maya + Jordan to pair on scoring implementation, Evan to finalize security answers, Priya to collect golden set, I’ll finalize pricing and legal terms. Ping here once you have deliverables. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: REQ-4521 status: deployment scheduled for 2026-05-02.
